about: The veil candidate's cast and trigger rules with the attack left to Forge (no attack policy), for a side-by-side run on the same tables. Only the playbook object is read.

playbook.notes: Version 2 (candidate, 2026-11-13). Written from 12 stock goldfish games (seeds 28001-28012) and tuned on the same seeds. Stock already takes every miracle it is offered (27 of 27 miracle triggers ended in the cast; 15 of 15 under this file), so the miracle draw needs no rule, and the rule format could not reach it anyway: the reveal is a static Drawn trigger and the cast is an optional Play effect decided by Forge's confirmAction, not by chooseSpellAbilityToPlay. What stock leaves undone in goldfish: the commander waits behind other plays (first cast on own turns 3 to 14, median 4.5), 50% of the mana goes unspent, and several bodies are never cast at all (Fear of Sleep Paralysis 7 games drawn, 0 cast; Dream Eater 6/0; Phenomenon Investigators 4/0; Doomwake Giant 3/0; the Rooms from hand 12/0). Rules: Sol Ring, then Aminatou the turn she is affordable, then the rocks; the enchantment engine with Sigil of the Empty Throne first and Secret Arcade (every permanent an enchantment, so every permanent spell feeds Sigil and Mesa); Entreat the Angels from hand at the largest X of two or more; The Master of Keys at X 2 to 4 while the library is deep; the bodies Forge sits on, and the Rooms (their first door); card selection guarded by library size; Hall of Heliod's Generosity after combat to put an enchantment card on top for next turn's miracle; Mind Stone and Commander's Sphere cracked late with an empty hand. Triggers: Mesa Enchantress's draw while the library is deep, the searches and copy of Moon-Blessed Cleric, Ondu Spiritdancer and Solemn. Tried and dropped: an activate rule to unlock the second door of a Room (an unlock is a static ability, ST$ UnlockDoor, which the activate rule does not see; Forge unlocks on its own). Answers (Swords, Utter End, Cast Out, Return to Dust, Arcane Denial, Terminus, Time Wipe, Inkshield) left to Forge for the second pass.
